notes.title: About our BETA v0.6 Patch Notes and Update
notes.notes:
Good Day Good Knights!

Back in the fall, we announced the launch date for King Arthur: Legends Rise would be delayed. We said that we were committed to putting in the work to make this game great, something we meant then and that we absolutely mean now. We promised that big changes were coming to get us there, and while a few of those changes arrived in our v0.5 update, v0.6 is where the bulk of those changes landed. So much so that it has grown beyond our best initial estimations. Simply put, we are not satisfied with where we landed and have therefore made the determination that we will need some additional time to address it.  As a result our patch notes, which have grown equally large, will be held back until the update details are finalized. We hope to soon share more about what you can expect to see in our update, but in the meantime, we hope you’ll continue to enjoy the game, and rack up those extra rewards prior to the Progression Reboot coming with v0.6.

Stay tuned for more information
-Kabam Pinwheel
